title: SAP Web Dispatcher does not sufficiently validate certain inputs during processing, which could lead… (CVE-2026-109800)
description: SAP Web Dispatcher has a vulnerability where it does not sufficiently validate certain inputs during processing. An authenticated non-administrative user can exploit this by sending specially crafted input, causing memory corruption that terminates the Web Dispatcher process. This results in denial of service, making the Web Dispatcher and all backend systems behind it unavailable. There is no impact on confidentiality or integrity.
